t: Community buy-in: What leaders gain by engaging communities in participatory decision-making and problem-solving
s: April 25, 2020 - Even if you are from the community you serve, started out as frontline staff or consider yourself to be very in-tune or “woke”, there are limits to the perspective of one person or even a small leadership team. Listening to folks on the frontlines who are expected to carry out next steps once the decision is made, as well as the people who are going to be impacted, will give you the insight and clarity you need to move in the right direction. By seeking buy-in from a larger audience and activating community brilliance, you will gain much needed expertise that will help you make better decisions, discover more creative solutions, and generate more innovative ideas.
